title: Preaching of the Word
definition: Preaching of the Word is the public proclamation and explanation of Scripture for the glory of God and the building up of His people.
summary: Preaching of the Word is the public proclamation and explanation of Scripture with authority, clarity, and Gospel aim.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is proclaimed as Lord, Savior, and fulfillment of Scripture through faithful preaching.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The preaching of the Word is the public proclamation and explanation of Scripture for faith, repentance, worship, and obedience. Scripture commands the Word to be preached with patience, clarity, and seriousness.

Preaching is not motivational speaking, personal storytelling, or religious entertainment. Its authority comes from Scripture, and its aim is to present Christ and form disciples.

Jesus is the message and Lord of true preaching. Faithful preaching opens the Word so people may hear God, see Christ, and respond in faith.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People are spiritually shaped by what is regularly placed before them. Preaching of the Word protects the church from personality-driven ministry and keeps God's voice central.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Listen to preaching with an open Bible and a ready heart. Preachers should labor for clarity and faithfulness, and hearers should respond with repentance, faith, worship, and obedience.
